records.context: Three conventions apply.  image data channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask workflow preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.label: spacr.core#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three conventions apply.  Channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask pipeline preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.translation: Tre konventioner gäller.  Kanalnummer är nollbaserade och diametrar anges i pixlar, så värden som kopierats från en förstoring kan inte överföras utan omräkning.  Standardpipelinen v1 för masker bevarar den kataloglayout som verktygen nedströms förväntar sig; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` är frivillig och skriver en annan, strömmande layout.  Slutligen tar borttagning av brus i UMAP-kluster även bort dessa objekt från den returnerade tabellen, så att tabellen och den synliga inbäddningen stämmer överens i stället för att andra prover returneras i tysthet.

records.context: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever extracted-image-region source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept an extracted image region folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) extracted-image-region folder is image data channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate application view does.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever crop source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept a crop folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) crop folder is channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate screen does.
records.translation: Miniatyrerna som läggs över inbäddningen kommer från den beskärningskälla som ``crop_source`` anger: ``'png'`` (och ``'auto'`` där det finns en mapp med utsnitt) läser de förgenererade PNG-filerna, ``'merged'`` (och ``'auto'`` utan mapp) skär ut vart och ett ur ``merged/*.npy`` vid behov via :mod:`spacr.crops`, så att inbäddningen kan ritas för ett projekt som aldrig behöll en mapp med utsnitt — ``png_list`` behövs inte i det fallet. I båda fallen kommer pixlarna via :mod:`spacr.crops`, så en äldre mapp med utsnitt (före 341f446) får kanalerna korrigerade vid inläsning och montaget visar samma bild som skärmen Annotate.

records.context: Given a source folder ``src`` of multi-image data channel images, this workflow (1) optionally consolidates inputs from nested folders, (2) renames files to the Yokogawa layout used downstream, (3) preprocesses per-image data channel arrays, (4) generates masks for cell / nucleus / pathogen / organelle image data channels via Cellpose (SAM variant), (5) optionally reconciles the cell mask against nuclei + pathogen overlays, and (6) writes overlay plots and a ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` next to the outputs.

records.source: Given a source folder ``src`` of multi-channel images, this pipeline (1) optionally consolidates inputs from nested folders, (2) renames files to the Yokogawa layout used downstream, (3) preprocesses per-channel arrays, (4) generates masks for cell / nucleus / pathogen / organelle channels via Cellpose (SAM variant), (5) optionally reconciles the cell mask against nuclei + pathogen overlays, and (6) writes overlay plots and a ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` next to the outputs.
records.translation: Utifrån en källmapp ``src`` med flerkanalsbilder gör denna pipeline följande: (1) samlar valfritt ihop indata från nästlade mappar, (2) byter namn på filer enligt den Yokogawa-layout som används nedströms, (3) förbehandlar arrayer per kanal, (4) genererar masker för kanalerna cell / kärna / patogen / organell med Cellpose (SAM-varianten), (5) stämmer valfritt av cellmasken mot överlägg av kärnor + patogener och (6) skriver överläggsdiagram och en ``gen_mask_settings.csv`` bredvid utdata.

records.source: The returned DataFrame always contains the columns ``path`` and ``pred``. A single-logit head is converted with ``torch.sigmoid``, so ``pred`` is the positive-class probability; a multi-logit head is converted with ``torch.softmax``, so ``pred`` is the probability of class 1 for two classes and the winning class's confidence for more. With more than two classes the frame also carries ``predicted_label`` and one ``prob_class_<i>`` column per class. Results are also written to a CSV file derived from ``model_path`` and the current date.
records.translation: Den returnerade DataFrame innehåller alltid kolumnerna ``path`` och ``pred``. Ett huvud med en logit konverteras med ``torch.sigmoid``, så ``pred`` är sannolikheten för den positiva klassen; ett huvud med flera logiter konverteras med ``torch.softmax``, så ``pred`` är sannolikheten för klass 1 vid två klasser och den vinnande klassens konfidens vid fler. Med fler än två klasser innehåller tabellen också ``predicted_label`` och en kolumn ``prob_class_<i>`` per klass. Resultaten skrivs också till en CSV-fil vars namn härleds från ``model_path`` och dagens datum.

records.context: ``crop_source`` chooses where the pixels come from. ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) copies the pre-generated PNGs, unchanged. ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no extracted-image-region folder) cuts each selected extracted image region out of ``merged/*.npy`` through :mod:`spacr.crops` instead: the labels still come from ``png_list``, but the pixels are cut fresh at the current extracted-image-region settings, so the training set costs no standing disk and cannot be built out of a folder that has gone stale. records.source: ``crop_source`` chooses where the pixels come from. ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) copies the pre-generated PNGs, unchanged. ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no crop folder) cuts each selected crop out of ``merged/*.npy`` through :mod:`spacr.crops` instead: the labels still come from ``png_list``, but the pixels are cut fresh at the current crop settings, so the training set costs no standing disk and cannot be built out of a folder that has gone stale. A project with no ``png_list`` at all falls back to the object measurement table, which still carries everything the metadata rules select on.
records.translation: ``crop_source`` väljer var pixlarna kommer ifrån. ``'png'`` (och ``'auto'`` där en utsnittsmapp finns) kopierar de förgenererade PNG-filerna oförändrade. ``'merged'`` (och ``'auto'`` utan utsnittsmapp) skär i stället ut varje valt utsnitt ur ``merged/*.npy`` via :mod:`spacr.crops`: etiketterna kommer fortfarande från ``png_list``, men pixlarna skärs ut på nytt med de aktuella beskärningsinställningarna, så träningsmängden tar inget permanent diskutrymme och kan inte byggas från en mapp som har blivit inaktuell. Ett projekt helt utan ``png_list`` faller tillbaka på objektets mättabell, som fortfarande innehåller allt som metadatareglerna väljer på.

records.context: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.label: spacr.io.make_validation_holdout#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.translation: Målandel av proverna som ska hållas undan, strikt mellan 0 och 1; varje tal utanför det intervallet, inklusive ``nan`` och ``inf``, ger ``ValueError``. Det är bara ett mål. Den undanhållna mängden är ett helt veck i en uppdelning i ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` veck, som i sin tur begränsas av antalet distinkta grupper, så den realiserade andelen kvantiseras till hela grupper och kan avvika åt båda hållen, och det rejält. Med åtta lika stora grupper håller 0.05 undan 0.125 (ingen finare uppdelning finns) och 0.7 håller undan 0.5 (golvet på två veck); med en dominerande grupp — 70 av 100 prover fördelade på fyra grupper — håller samma två önskemål i stället undan 0.10 och 0.70. records.context: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` structured-data names and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a processing session is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` keys and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a run is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.translation: Förbättringskedjan följer samma väg. Kedjan i Make Masks (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) skrivs till en inställningsfil som nycklarna ``enhance_*`` och läses tillbaka här av :func:`prepare_chain`, med inställningarna ``psf_*`` inlagda som kedjans PSF-steg, så att en körning av en platta tillämpar exakt de steg som en kurator har finjusterat, i kedjans egen ordning: bakgrund, PSF, brusreducering, kontrast, skärpning. Sessionen tillämpar den per vald kanal i det steg där PSF redan kördes -- efter belysningskorrigering och före normalisering -- och dess härkomst skrivs till samma post ``psf/segmentation_application.json``, så att en ändrad kedja avvisas vid återupptagning på samma sätt som en ändrad kärna. Utan något aktiverat kedjesteg är en körning byte för byte densamma som innan kedjan fanns.

records.source: A settings file names its barcodes under ``barcode_set``, as a list with one entry per barcode. records.translation: En inställningsfil namnger sina streckkoder under ``barcode_set``, som en lista med en post per streckkod. records.context: An entry named after one of the three barcodes spaCR shipped keeps the spellings that barcode has always had, for every field the settings file does not spell out itself. records.translation: Cellpose 4 levereras med exakt en standardmodell, ``cpsam`` (``cellpose.models.MODEL_NAMES == ['cpsam']``), och ``CellposeModel(model_type=...)`` accepteras men ignoreras. records.source: Run plaque, recruitment, invasion, and replication assays.
records.translation: Kör plack-, rekryterings-, invasions- och replikationsanalyser.

records.context: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.label: spacr.submodules#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.translation: Fyra spaCR-paneler delar för närvarande den här startsidan, men de besvarar olika biologiska frågor.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segmenterar plackbilder och sammanfattar antal plack och plackarea.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` mäter en fluorescerande markör runt patogener eller vakuoler i förhållande till värdcellens cytoplasma. :func:`analyze_invasion` använder differentiell färgning före/efter permeabilisering för att klassificera parasiter som fästa utanför eller invaderade inuti en värdcell. :func:`analyze_replication` räknar parasiter i varje parasitofor vakuol och jämför de resulterande fördelningarna av replikationsstadier.  Verktyg för träning, testning och tillämpning av Cellpose-modeller finns också här, men de ersätter inte dessa fyra startpunkter för analyserna.

records.context: For plaques, inspect the masks before interpreting counts or areas.  For Recruitment, verify the object filters, condition annotation, and per-microplate sample position denominators before comparing treatments.  For Invasion, review microscope field of view-level thresholds, control agreement, bimodality, and sensitivity flags before using the efficiency table.  For Replication, inspect the vacuole grouping and the reported non-power-of-two fraction before comparing doubling distributions. Follow the specific function links above until the four microscope image fields receive separate API destinations.
records.label: spacr.submodules#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: For plaques, inspect the masks before interpreting counts or areas.  For Recruitment, verify the object filters, condition annotation, and per-well denominators before comparing treatments.  For Invasion, review field-level thresholds, control agreement, bimodality, and sensitivity flags before using the efficiency table.  For Replication, inspect the vacuole grouping and the reported non-power-of-two fraction before comparing doubling distributions. records.translation: För plack: granska maskerna innan antal eller areor tolkas.  För Recruitment: kontrollera objektfiltren, annoteringen av betingelser och nämnarna per brunn innan behandlingar jämförs.  För Invasion: granska trösklar på fältnivå, överensstämmelse med kontroller, bimodalitet och känslighetsflaggor innan effektivitetstabellen används.  För Replication: granska grupperingen av vakuoler och den rapporterade andelen som inte är en tvåpotens innan fördelningar av fördubblingar jämförs. Följ de specifika funktionslänkarna ovan tills de fyra panelerna får separata API-destinationer.

records.context: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal image layer off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside image data channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per microscope field of view in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal plane off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per field in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.translation: Utformningen följer av denna asymmetri. "Inside" (inuti) definieras av en frånvaro, och frånvaro är den opålitliga riktningen. Dålig antikroppspenetration, ett fokalplan som inte ligger vid parasitens ekvator, fotoblekning, en parasit med lågt uttryck — var och en av dessa tar bort utsidessignal från en parasit som befinner sig utanför, och var och en gör därför att invasionseffektiviteten *överskattas*. Inget rimligt driver felet åt andra hållet. Tröskeln på utsidekanalen är det enda tal som analysen vilar på, så den härleds från data, rapporteras per fält i ``fields``, kontrolleras mot en kontrollbaserad gräns när en sådan finns och omges av ett känslighetspar som visar hur mycket av svaret som beror på tröskeln.

records.context: Three design decisions:
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three design decisions:
records.translation: Tre designbeslut:

records.context: **The threshold is per microscope field of view.** Illumination and staining vary microscope field of view to microscope field of view, and a laboratory microplate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The threshold is per field.** Illumination and staining vary field to field, and a plate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.translation: **Tröskeln sätts per fält.** Belysning och färgning varierar från fält till fält, och en gräns för hela plattan gör en belysningsgradient till en invasionsgradient. Se :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.

records.context: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per microscope field of view and per microplate sample position, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A threshold without two populations is arbitrary.** Otsu splits a single smear of signal down the middle and return a confident number. ``bimodality_coefficient`` and ``qc_flag_unimodal`` say when that has happened, per field and per well, instead of letting it pass silently. See :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.
records.translation: **En tröskel utan två populationer är godtycklig.** Otsu delar ett enda utsmetat signalband på mitten och returnerar ett säkert tal. ``bimodality_coefficient`` och ``qc_flag_unimodal`` anger när detta har hänt, per fält och per brunn, i stället för att låta det passera obemärkt. Se :func:`_bimodality_coefficient`.

records.context: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a microplate sample position, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_replication#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a well, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.
records.translation: *Toxoplasma gondii* förökar sig genom endodyogeni, där två dotterceller bildas inuti en modercell, så en parasitofor vakuol innehåller 1, 2, 4, 8 eller 16 parasiter — en tvåpotens. Avläsningen i en replikationsanalys är därför **fördelningen** av parasiter per vakuol i en brunn, inte ett medelvärde: ett medelvärde på 3.2 kan inte skilja "everything at 3-ish" (allt kring 3), vilket är biologiskt omöjligt, från en sund blandning av 2:or och 4:or. Ett läkemedel som bromsar replikationen flyttar massa från klasserna 8 och 4 ned till 2 och 1, och bara fördelningen visar det.

records.context: **The counting unit is the vacuole.** Not the parasite, and not the host cell — one host cell routinely carries several vacuoles, so grouping on ``cell_id`` reports their combined count as a single vacuole and produces a plausible but meaningless number. See :func:`_assign_vacuole_ids` for how the vacuole is derived and what each ``vacuole_key`` costs you.

records.translation: **Räkneenheten är vakuolen.** Inte parasiten, och inte värdcellen — en värdcell har ofta flera vakuoler, så att gruppera på ``cell_id`` rapporterar deras sammanlagda antal som en enda vakuol och ger ett rimligt men meningslöst tal. records.context: Rosettes of 3, 5, 6 or 7 are counted into an explicit ``non_power_of_two`` bucket that is always reported and never folded into a neighbouring bucket. records.source: This is a separate pass rather than a branch inside the segmenter because the two shapes of input differ in what a result row means. One field per image gives one row per image; a plate gives one row per well, and the well has to be named or the conditions are pooled into a single meaningless count. Splitting first makes every downstream row a well, whichever shape arrived.
records.translation: Detta är ett separat pass snarare än en gren i segmenteraren, eftersom de två formerna av indata skiljer sig i vad en resultatrad betyder. Ett fält per bild ger en rad per bild; en platta ger en rad per brunn, och brunnen måste namnges, annars slås betingelserna ihop till ett enda meningslöst antal. Att dela först gör varje rad nedströms till en brunn, oavsett vilken form som kom in.

A lower bound still catches cases such as eight workers holding a 900 MB field each on a 16 GB laptop. The measured peak is what :func:`spacr.benchmark.benchmark` reports, and this card says so rather than inventing a multiplier for it.
records.translation: Härlett: minnet rapporteras som en nedre gräns -- ``n_jobs`` arbetare som var och en håller ett fält är det minsta som körningen kan använda, före en enda arbetskopia. En nedre gräns fångar ändå fall som åtta arbetare som var och en håller ett fält på 900 MB på en laptop med 16 GB. Den uppmätta toppen är det som :func:`spacr.benchmark.benchmark` rapporterar, och kortet säger det i stället för att hitta på en multiplikator för den.
